<translate>
'''Earth''' is the vanilla Overworld (<code>minecraft:overworld</code>), the world where every character starts. DragonMineZ doesn't add a separate Earth dimension: it fills the Overworld with the homes of most [[Special:MyLanguage/Masters|masters]], landmark structures, Dragon Ball wildlife and enemies, the Earth Dragon Balls that summon [[Special:MyLanguage/Shenron|Shenron]], the world boss [[Special:MyLanguage/Turles|Turles]] and the [[Special:MyLanguage/Saiyan Assault|Saiyan Assault]] raid.
</translate>

<translate>
== Gravity ==
</translate>
{{Config|Gravity Config|gravityPerWorld}}
<translate>
Earth has normal gravity (×1.0) by default. You can raise it locally with a [[Special:MyLanguage/Gravity Device|Gravity Device]] or train with [[Special:MyLanguage/Weights|weights]].
</translate>

<translate>
== Biomes ==
</translate>
<translate>
Earth keeps every vanilla biome. DragonMineZ adds the '''Rocky''' biome, where [[Special:MyLanguage/Saibamen|Saibamen]] sprout and [[Special:MyLanguage/Dinosaurs|dinosaurs]] roam; many [[Special:MyLanguage/Sagas|saga]] fights take place there.
</translate>

</translate>

<translate>
== Dragon Balls ==
</translate>
{{Main|Shenron}}
<translate>
The seven Earth Dragon Balls are scattered around the world spawn (within 1,000 blocks by default). Find them with the [[Special:MyLanguage/Dragon Radar|Dragon Radar]] and bring them together to summon [[Special:MyLanguage/Shenron|Shenron]]. See [[Special:MyLanguage/Dragons and Wishes|Dragons and Wishes]].
</translate>

<translate>
== World boss and raid ==
</translate>
<translate>
* '''[[Special:MyLanguage/Turles|Turles]]''' sleeps in the clearing under the [[Special:MyLanguage/Tree of Might|Tree of Might]]. See [[Special:MyLanguage/World Bosses|World Bosses]].
* Killing the scout at a [[Special:MyLanguage/Saiyan Crater|Saiyan Crater]] starts the '''[[Special:MyLanguage/Saiyan Assault|Saiyan Assault]]''' raid. See [[Special:MyLanguage/Raids|Raids]].
</translate>

<translate>
== Getting there ==
</translate>
<translate>
* Every character starts on Earth.
* The [[Special:MyLanguage/Space Pod|Space Pod]] destination '''Earth''' is always available and lands you at the same X, Y and Z you left from.
* In the [[Special:MyLanguage/Otherworld|Otherworld]], [[Special:MyLanguage/King Yemma|King Yemma]] sends you back to your spawn point when you're alive or on a temporary return.
* The portal inside the [[Special:MyLanguage/Hyperbolic Time Chamber|Hyperbolic Time Chamber]] takes you back to [[Special:MyLanguage/Kami's Lookout|Kami's Lookout]].
</translate>
